Do not conflate rubella (German measles) with measles (rubeola) — both may appear in MMR-related reporting

MMWR reports for Q1 2025 may not be published until Q2 2025 — anticipate reporting lag in peer-reviewed source availability
State health department websites vary in update frequency and data granularity — cross-validate with CDC national totals
Any reported measles death in the US during Q1 2025 is a high-priority, high-sensitivity extraction — verify with multiple sources before recording

iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_coverage_assessment: Strong. All major target fields are covered by at least one authoritative source: (a) cases_confirmed — CDC HAN (208 as of Mar 7), MMWR West Texas (325 Jan 20–Mar 18), WHO DON (378 Jan 1–Mar 20), DSHS Texas page; (b) deaths — WHO DON (2 deaths through Mar 20, within Q1), ABC7NY/ABCNews (first Texas child death late February = within Q1; second Texas death April = outside Q1), MMWR West Texas (1 death within Jan–Mar window); (c) hospitalizations — MMWR West Texas (60/325 = 18.5%), WHO DON (17% overall rate), CDC HAN (18 hospitalized at 124-case snapshot); (d) subnational_location — Texas (West Texas / South Plains / Lubbock), New Mexico (Lea County), Oklahoma, Kansas mentioned; (e) date_reported — multiple date-stamped snapshots across January–March 2025; (f) source_url — cdc.gov (HAN, MMWR ×2, data page), who.int (DON561), dshs.texas.gov, nmhealth.org (×2), publichealth.jhu.edu, abc7ny.com, abcnews.com, cidrap.umn.edu; (g) source_type — official_public_health_agency, international_organization_report, peer_reviewed_literature (MMWR), news_and_situation_report, structured_tracker all represented.
iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_trustworthiness_assessment: High. Primary evidence anchors are CDC (cdc.gov — HAN advisory, MMWR ×2, data page), WHO (who.int — DON561), Texas DSHS (dshs.texas.gov), and New Mexico DOH (nmhealth.org). These are the highest-authority sources for US measles surveillance. MMWR reports are peer-reviewed CDC publications with precise date ranges and case counts. News sources (ABC7NY, ABCNews) cite DSHS press releases directly and are used only for corroboration of death timing. JHU IVAC tracker compiles from official state/county sources. PAHO appeared 6 times but no confirming snippet text was returned — treat as a candidate source pending content verification rather than a confirmed evidence anchor. Reddit and respiratory-therapy.com are lower-trust and should be used only as corroborating signals, not primary evidence.
